title: Cost of the LCFs' meaning: how much of the seven LCFs a linear map or a small network reads from the latents
description: For every free encoder behind a configuration of exp-lcf-cost-report-322, on each of its five training seeds (lcft-freefix-none-sN, the clone of BBRv3, from exp-lcf-cost-teacher-317 and exp-lcf-cost-teacher-seeds-321; lcf-free-c0.01-lr1e-4-n60k-sN, expliCCit's CQL, from exp-lcf-cost-315 and exp-lcf-cost-seeds-320), two maps from the seven latents to each of neto1 v1's LCFs, in neto1 v1's target space, fitted on the training links of the policy's own split of exp-data-net2-steps-222 and scored by R^2 on its validation links, every 10th step (experiments/latent_probe.py): a linear map with a bias, and a network with two hidden layers of 128 fitted to all seven at once. References: neto1 v1's own output (the paper arm's latents) and the free encoder with fresh weights. Release exp-lcf-cost-probe-319 had the linear map on seeds 0 and 1 only.
run: N="$IN/n/$(cat "$IN/n/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; A=(); for s in 0 1 2 3 4; do T="$IN/t"; F="$IN/p"; [ "$s" -ge 2 ] && { T="$IN/u"; F="$IN/s"; }; A+=("lcft-freefix-none-s$s=$T/lcft-freefix-none-s$s" "lcf-free-c0.01-lr1e-4-n60k-s$s=$F/lcf-free-c0.01-lr1e-4-n60k-s$s"); done; A+=("lcf-paper-c0.1-lr1e-4-n60k-s0=$IN/p/lcf-paper-c0.1-lr1e-4-n60k-s0"); for a in "${A[@]}"; do [ -f "${a#*=}/train_spec.json" ]; done; [ "${#A[@]}" -eq 11 ]; uv run python experiments/latent_probe.py "$OUT" "$IN/d" "$N" "${A[@]}" random=random
